## Code Review

This pull request implements a write-path remediation for the run-helper.sh script in the Windows Hyper-V runner deployment. Following a pilot failure where the runner remained offline due to systemd's strict read-only system policy blocking the runner's entrypoint from writing to run-helper.sh, the image provisioner now pre-creates the target file with runner ownership, and the systemd service unit grants write access specifically to that file. The configuration, documentation, and bundle validation scripts are updated to reflect the new golden image SHA-256 and the new validation rules. Feedback on the pull request suggests improving the robustness of the bundle validation script (validate-bundle.mjs) by adding the newly referenced files to the pre-validated requiredFiles list and wrapping file read operations in try-catch blocks to ensure stable, fail-closed diagnostics.
